drift_cross_check_reference_only.note: scan-era identity/base cells vs crosstab cells for the same capture and map; Welch reference only, never used in any verdict

interpretation_rules: an interval crossing zero means compatible with zero, not proof of no effect and not equivalence
equivalence is claimed only when the interval lies wholly inside [-epsilon,+epsilon]
negative effects are preserved exactly as measured
no best-start, repeat, prefix or subset selection was applied
crosstab numbers are layer-replay completion times, not server-side latencies

verdict_rules.common_static_sufficient: some base column's delta-vs-own CI lower bound is <= epsilon in every row (not significantly worse beyond the practical margin anywhere)
verdict_rules.row_tracks_own_base: both other-base-minus-own-base paired CIs exclude zero positively
verdict_rules.tracking_room_supported: >=2 of 3 rows track their own base
